protocol.output_cap: up to 10 listings per task (extras truncated)
protocol.invocations: one invocation per task, no agent re-attempts; a single transport-level retry is allowed only when the vendor API 5xxs before producing any output
protocol.tool_config: claude: web_search_20260209 + web_fetch_20260209, max_uses 12 each, pause_turn continuation cap 8; openai: web_search; gemini: google_search grounding; grok: server-side web_search via /v1/responses; perplexity: Agent API built-in search, preset=high, real image input (normalized base64 data URI); exa: /search deep mode + outputSchema (TEXT-ONLY — image passed as a URL line, disclosed asymmetry); parallel: Task API + JSON output_schema (TEXT-ONLY — image passed as a URL line, disclosed asymmetry); findcheap: /search as shipped (exact track: exact_brand=True)
protocol.max_execution: findcheap 360s HTTP timeout; baselines 600s HTTP timeout per call
protocol.geography: US retailers, US-shippable; buyer location for calculated shipping pinned to ZIP 10001 (generic major-metro ZIP — manual checks enter the same ZIP in retailer estimators, so automated and manual shipping checks agree; calculated shipping varies by destination, disclosed in limitations)
protocol.shipping_basis: non-Prime / no membership programs (Jake ruling 2026-08-29, consistent with the no-membership-prices rule): Amazon >= $35 ships free, under $35 resolved by manual logged-out checks at ZIP 10001 in the pre-run --ref-shipping pass, which pins every reference's non-deterministic shipping BEFORE searches; a Prime counterfactual (all Amazon shipping $0, ~75% of US Amazon shoppers have Prime) is reported separately via --report --prime
protocol.transport: the claude searcher column runs through the Message Batches API (Jake ruling 2026-08-28) — identical model/tools/prompts, tokens billed at 50% batch rates (per-search fees unchanged); chosen over halving that column's N, which would have thinned the pooled oracle on the skipped tasks and broken column comparability. Its per-task latency is not measurable under batch scheduling (latency_s=null; the rehearsal's interactive medians are the cited latency figures). The batch analog of the single transport-level retry re-submits errored/expired batch results once. All other columns are interactive HTTP
protocol.pack_normalization: multi-pack references (2026-08-26): candidates with different pack counts qualify on the equivalence track and are scored on landed price PER UNIT — (item + mandatory shipping) / pack count — matching production's price-per-count display; the exact track still requires the same count
protocol.shipping_policies: hard-coded published thresholds (2026-08-26): Amazon/Walmart/Target/Best Buy free >= $35 (under: Walmart $6.99, Target $5.99, Amazon/Best Buy vary); Kohl's free >= $49 else $8.95; Macy's free >= $49; Chewy free >= $49 else $4.99; Shein free >= $29; Sephora free >= $50; Apple and Nordstrom always free
protocol.shipping: LANDED COST (2026-08-25): 'cheaper' = item price + mandatory shipping for a single-item order to a US address, no paid memberships. Numeric shipping probed via eBay/Walmart APIs; agent-reported shipping used elsewhere; unknown shipping resolved at the price frontier (R&D: human audit; final run: automated page-text extraction). The REFERENCE is landed too: origin page's item price + its own mandatory shipping under the same rules.
protocol.discounts: no coupons, promo codes, membership-gated prices, or first-order/new-customer WELCOME prices (AliExpress/Temu/Shein-style) — the basis is the standing price available to any shopper
protocol.findcheap_prices: Findcheap item prices are vendor-API sourced and treated as verified (Jake's ruling 2026-08-26); its shipping and stock are audited like everyone else's
